preconditions.description: The length of the array a must be between 2 and 140582.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= b_i <= 187126 for b_i in b)
preconditions.description: Each element of the array b must be a non-negative integer not exceeding 187126.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' and all(1 <= a_i <= 10**18 for a_i in a)
postconditions.description: If a valid array a exists, output 'YES' followed by the array a with each element between 1 and 10^18.
If no valid array a can be restored, output 'NO'.
